repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-lyra
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.lyra for Lyra spaces (room devices). getAdvertisedEndpoint() resolves an ultrasound token to the advertising space through the proximity service. The space child lists and reads the user's spaces, joins (default pass type MANUAL, with the current device url) and leaves them, verifies occupants, reads bindings, and binds and unbinds conversations with KMS create and delete authorization messages for the space identity; join, leave, bindConversation, and unbindConversation take a space.url relative to the lyra service, while the other space methods take an absolute one. The device child reads and reports audio state and invokes mute, unmute, and volume actions under the audio resource of the space url. It stores nothing itself.

lyra-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-mercury, @webex/internal-plugin-encryption, @webex/internal-plugin-conversation, and @webex/internal-plugin-feature, then registers Lyra as internal plugin 'lyra' with config {lyra: {}}; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports the default Lyra class and the named config. webex.internal.lyra exposes getAdvertisedEndpoint and the children space (list, get, join, leave, verifyOccupant, getCurrentBindings, bindConversation, unbindConversation, deleteBinding, plus _bindConversation) and device (getAudioState, putAudioState, mute, unmute, increaseVolume, decreaseVolume, setVolume); specified in src/docs/README.md.

lyra-http.source: Lyra service (catalog service name lyra, reached through api: 'lyra' and through caller-supplied space URLs in src/space.js and src/device.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
lyra-http.summary: GET /spaces and /spaces/<id>; PUT and DELETE <space.url>/occupants/@me (body {pass: {type, data}, deviceUrl, verificationInitiation}; optional query deviceUrl); PUT <space.url>/occupants/<occupantId> with pass type VERIFICATION; GET, POST, and DELETE <space.url>/bindings with a KMS authorization message in the body or, wrapped, in the query; DELETE <space.url>/bindings/<bindingId>; GET and PUT <space.url>/audio; POST <space.url>/audio/microphones/actions/{mute,un-mute}/invoke and <space.url>/audio/volume/actions/{increase,decrease,set}/invoke.

proximity-http.source: Proximity service (catalog service name proximity, reached through api: 'proximity' in src/lyra.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
proximity-http.summary: GET /ultrasound/advertisements?token=<decoded ultrasound token> resolving the advertised endpoint: advertiser {id, displayName, orgId}, links addMeToSpace and lyra_space, proof, and token.
